name: FlyGarden
assessment: Substantial connectome/body integration, persistent state, experiments, tests and explicit provenance. Publish as an engineered hybrid research workspace; useful full-brain choice and behavioral learning remain unresolved. GitHub remote configured; reproduction requires omitted upstream inputs.

name: RallyAI3
assessment: Unity vehicle simulation, PPO infrastructure, course generation, frozen checkpoints and evaluation dashboard. Publish the lab; do not imply a successful full-course driving policy. GitHub remote configured.

name: PyDrive / Supra AI
assessment: Substantial custom driving dynamics, PPO, viewers, audio and tests. Select a canonical working tree before migrating: PyDrive v2, Supra Cambrian and Supra Evo share its GitHub remote and are competing descendants.

name: Melee Lab (v1)
assessment: Real emulator integration, PPO infrastructure, evaluation tooling and native brain visualizer. Publish with independent setup instructions; exclude game images and machine-local settings. melee bot v1 appears to be a preserved copy, not a separate portfolio project.

name: Puff Bot Lab (v2)
assessment: Distinct Jigglypuff successor with independent workers, training dashboard and evaluation tests. Publish with measured results and known evaluation limitations; exclude bundled game material and archives.

name: Flapping Flight RL
assessment: Meaningful aerodynamic prototype and CFD verification investigation with retained failures and research provenance. Publish as work in progress. Stage A remains FAILED / UNVALIDATED; no validated hawkmoth hover or physically grounded PPO result. GitHub remote configured.

name: Sonic Atlas
assessment: Coherent set of seven interactive acoustic experiments, physics modules, tests and clear model boundaries. Strong accessible demonstration.

name: Organless
assessment: Compact but substantive learned shared cell-allocation policy, deterministic training, injury comparisons and held-out evaluation. Publish as abstract artificial life, with injury benchmark limits.

name: Civilia
assessment: Deterministic social simulation with needs, memory, relationships, construction, decision traces and persistence. Current foundation is substantial despite the larger unfinished roadmap. Older New project 2 copy is a predecessor.

name: Python Dojo
assessment: Packaged learning engine with exercises, grading, adaptive progress, browser/terminal interfaces and tests. Better standalone candidate than the earlier terminal-only tutor.

name: Bellwether
assessment: SEC ingestion, extraction, backtesting and alert infrastructure with tests. Publish as filing analysis tooling; tiny extraction evaluation does not establish trading advantage. Remove credentials, personal email configuration and local databases. GitHub remote configured.

name: WHOOP Personal Recovery Lab
assessment: Coherent local OAuth/SQLite dashboard, interpretive and raw-data views, tests and environment example. Publish code and synthetic examples; exclude personal records, tokens and .env.

name: Asclepius
assessment: Packaged WHOOP MCP server and statistical analysis layer with setup and privacy documentation. Distinct enough from Recovery Lab to keep separately, or share common ingestion later. Exclude personal auth/data.

name: BioFactory
assessment: Substantial ant logistics implementation, pheromone fields, resource demands and tests. Publish as an exploratory simulator without implying validated collective intelligence.

name: CRUMPLE
assessment: Distinct custom spring-beam vehicle deformation simulator with documented plasticity and driving controls. Strong small demonstration; add repeatable run and collision checks during preparation.

name: Floating Sandbox
assessment: Particle water, breakable ship structures, flooding, blueprint import and CPU/WebGPU paths. Worth publishing as a physics toy; verify the documented scenarios first. Prefer this organized tree over the patch-heavy Water Sim predecessor.

name: Rally Evolution Lab
assessment: Standalone browser neuroevolution racing experiment with multiple course lengths, comparison tooling and tests. Accessible demo distinct from the Unity lab.

name: PULSE-16
assessment: Procedural instruments, sequencer, piano/arpeggiator, DSP and exports in a coherent desktop music tool. Publish after a short audio/export smoke check.

name: SMW-RL
assessment: Substantial per-level PPO and emulator harness with documented partial success and curriculum limits. Publish as incomplete RL research, not a complete speedrunner. Exclude ROMs and review emulator redistribution.

name: RallyAI2
assessment: Substantial Python simulation and replay/control-room architecture with tests. Establish whether this remains an independent project or historical predecessor to RallyAI3; reconcile roadmap and measured outcomes before presenting it.

name: Personal Cambrian
assessment: Real generative encoding, morphogenesis and MuJoCo compilation with extensive tests. Full co-evolution and open-ended novelty loop remain unfinished; reconcile the scaffold wording with later stage records.

name: SoonerGrid
assessment: Traffic simulator, conservation checks and experiment provenance are substantial. Remains exploratory/uncalibrated; a fresh reproducible benchmark and dashboard evidence would strengthen publication.

name: Parkour Lab
assessment: Useful staged MuJoCo learning pipeline and checkpoint/evaluation handling. README and later stage artifacts disagree; resolve current stage and demonstrate fixed-seed terrain performance.

name: Off-Road Rover RL
assessment: Custom vehicle/terrain/LIDAR, evolution and dashboard exist. Portable dependencies and evaluation evidence need work; launcher currently borrows another project's Python environment and research-grade wording is too strong.

name: Cat & Mouse / Cryptographic Heist
assessment: Strong pursuit, radio/spoofing, replay and multi-agent environment backbone. Scripted baselines are implemented; learned pursuit/deception and reliable reproduction need demonstration.

name: Hybrid Lab
assessment: Separate viewer/training module and tests. Recheck lifecycle reliability and clarify relationship to the larger PyDrive family before giving it an independent repo.

name: Sonic Scenery
assessment: Audio helper, Spotify integration and procedural-world modules exist. README explicitly calls it a scaffold with unwired build; prove end-to-end live audio/world integration.

name: Vault Scribe
assessment: Substantial note classification, linking and duplicate handling. Make paths configurable and prove behavior against a synthetic vault; exclude the real personal vault.

name: Stride Lab
assessment: Runnable simplified athletic policy-search experiment with tests. Strengthen repeatability and describe the reduced mechanics accurately; not validated human biomechanics.

name: AegisMM
assessment: Order book, stochastic quoting, residual PPO, risk modules and tests. Reproducible cost-aware synthetic/paper benchmarks needed; institutional-grade/profitability language is unsupported by this review.

name: Trading AI HFT
assessment: Meaningful trading research modules and tests. Establish an offline default, remove secrets, and demonstrate held-out evaluation including costs before publication.

name: Tandem Drift RL
assessment: Two-car environment, scoring, physics tests and training code. Needs dependency/setup documentation and measured learned-policy evaluation.

name: Drone GA / ApexFlock / ML Drift Master
assessment: Several substantial simulations mixed into one workspace: drone racing, flocking and drift. Split coherent projects and match each README to its actual implementation.

name: Evolution Sandbox Collection
assessment: Darwin's Doodles, Siege Mech Evolution and Biosphere Co-Evolution have implemented simulation/evolution code. Add reproducible checks and verify learning claims; likely publish as a collection.

name: Physics Lab Studio
assessment: Large suite of standalone educational simulations. Audit equations, interactions and source attribution; organize common assets and replace the anonymous Downloads folder with a coherent package.

name: Ochem Class Companion
assessment: Recording/timeline/notes/export workflow exists with candid limits. Live AI output remains unvalidated; verify transcription/explanation and exclude lectures, images and sessions.

name: Ink Current Reactor
assessment: Coherent local audio-reactive aquarium application. Needs a repeatable build/playback demo and clearer provenance before publication.

name: Mission Control
assessment: Useful launcher/catalog tool with a coherent server and UI. Generalize machine-specific paths and ship a sample catalog so it is useful beyond this Mac.

name: LectureCanvas
assessment: Audio/transcription and word visualization code exists. Verify the real recording-to-transcript flow and use sample inputs with clear redistribution rights.

name: Neural Racer Evolution
assessment: Meaningful evolutionary racing and spectator implementation. Needs setup docs, deterministic benchmark and a representative recorded run.

name: Braindance Dream Machine
assessment: RAVE-based music tooling and studio UI exist. Verify model loading/training/generation, distinguish pretrained-model use from original learning, and exclude copyrighted training audio.

name: Aegis sword-and-shield RL
assessment: Unity ragdoll/self-play foundation and plan exist, but much less implemented substance than the envisioned dueling system. Needs a working duel/control baseline and measured evaluation.

name: Orbital Docking RL
assessment: Small environment/training prototype. Needs mechanics checks, an evaluation harness and evidence of rendezvous/docking behavior.

name: SMW Bowser hybrid harness
assessment: DirectorFSM/Lua adapter/tests form a useful harness, but an end-to-end real-emulator Bowser result is not established in this review. Duplicate exists in New project 2.

name: HealthBridge
assessment: Substantial parsers and health-report UI, but personal ancestry/wearable files are mixed with code and medical scoring requires validation. First sanitize, package and test with synthetic fixtures; do not publish the raw folder.

name: Car AI Copilot
assessment: Demo-data vehicle-assistant interface. Needs real ingestion/retrieval or a clearly scoped standalone demonstration of one feature.

name: LR4 Valet Copilot
assessment: Car-specific prototype interface using mock assumptions. Needs actual telemetry/hardware integration and verified behavior.

name: Mothership WHOOP
assessment: Earlier dashboard implementation with template-level setup docs. Establish a distinct function beyond the stronger WHOOP tools or consolidate it.

name: Alpaca 10-Agent Trader
assessment: Small ensemble/dashboard experiment with hard-coded credentials detected in source. Remove and rotate exposed credentials, then establish safe paper-mode reproduction and sound evaluation.

name: Room Planner
assessment: Folder name hides a room-planner package. Clarify product scope, document controls and verify geometry/save behavior before considering it a significant standalone repo.

name: Synapse
assessment: Single-file personal vault ingestion tool. Extract reusable configuration and isolate private notes/API access; Vault Scribe is currently the stronger publication candidate.

name: Synthwave Demolition 3D
assessment: Small Panda3D/Bullet sandbox. Needs a coherent run guide, asset attribution and a demonstrated complete gameplay loop.

name: Early driving/visualizer prototypes
assessment: Spotify Car/Night Cruise, drift-rl, evolving-cars, early Supra forks and terminal Python Dojo are smaller predecessors. Keep as examples or archive unless they offer a distinct capability.

name: Reaction Room
assessment: Course-aligned chemistry study tool. Private source snapshot; course-specific content is not cleared for public distribution.

name: PyDrive variant: pydrive-v2
assessment: Separate source snapshot preserving this local variant. No canonical or superior performance claim.

name: PyDrive variant: supra-cambrian
assessment: Separate source snapshot preserving this local variant. No canonical or superior performance claim.

name: PyDrive variant: supra-evo
assessment: Separate source snapshot preserving this local variant. No canonical or superior performance claim.

name: PyDrive variant: supra-five-speed
assessment: Separate source snapshot preserving this local variant. No canonical or superior performance claim.

name: PyDrive variant: supra-audio-v4
assessment: Separate source snapshot preserving this local variant. No canonical or superior performance claim.

name: Melee Next experimental successor
assessment: Unfinished independent successor pipeline, preserved without claims of training or dashboard readiness.
